title: Figure 11: Balanced homodyne detector using fictitious beam splitters for detection losses
description: Line schematic of a balanced homodyne detector in which signal â and local oscillator (αLO) combine at a beam splitter, with additional fictitious beam splitters admitting "vacuum" modes b̂1 and b̂2 before each detector, and the detector outputs joined at a minus node. Caption reads "Figure 11. Balanced Homodyne Detector Using Fictitious Beam Splitters to Account for Detection Losses. (courtesy of Ulf Leonhardt)."
